en: A proposed bill must pass both the Senate and the House of Representatives before the President can sign it into law.
When the President vetoes a proposed bill, the Congress can override it by securing a two-thirds majority vote from both houses.
When registered citizens cast their ballots during elections, they elect local and national representatives to govern the country.
When Filipino citizens pay income taxes to the government, the state uses these funds to build public infrastructure.
When citizens display the Philippine flag with the red stripe positioned at the top, it signifies a state of war.
Dr. Fe del Mundo designed a bamboo incubator that uses heated water in outer jars to keep newborn babies warm.
Marine scientist Dr. Angel Alcala established no-fishing ocean sanctuaries to protect coral reefs and increase surrounding fish populations.
The Ifugao carve step-like terraces into mountainsides to slow down rainwater runoff and prevent soil erosion on steep slopes.
Farmers in Lucban decorate their homes with colorful kiping to express gratitude to San Isidro Labrador for a bountiful harvest.
Community members physically carry an entire nipa hut on their shoulders to help a relocating family move their home.
Ancient Filipinos carved specific Baybayin characters onto bamboo tubes to record property transactions and communicate written messages.
Jose Rizal wrote the novel Noli Me Tangere to expose the abuses of Spanish friars and awaken Filipino national consciousness.
